description: Post-timeout recovery for a course creation by its operation key: NOT_STARTED (safe to submit the same key), IN_PROGRESS (retry the SAME key + payload to converge), SUCCEEDED (organization-scoped course returned), or KEY_UNAVAILABLE (use a fresh key). Requires lms:read.

operationKey.description: Durable-receipt idempotency key: 8-128 characters of letters, digits, dot, underscore, dash, or colon. Same key + same payload replays the stored receipt; same key + changed payload is a 409.

name: opentrain_lms_recover_course_create
